<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Market Correction:</strong> The Nifty and Sensex have declined for five consecutive sessions, resulting in a weekly loss of over 2.3% as investors react to rising crude oil prices and sustained FII selling.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxQLXpERktscWpOejhqd3BacDdvUFI1eE5VcnFOWHZQZl80c2FwdmIzMUdkZEhNMmVpZDg1bXF6UHJGZml1LWlXdGFJSThTcjAxZk5OelVBclBneG84ZTJ4bVcxOXdOLWtuWWpLWGM5RnlFdFJnVU9jN1B4MWdENGtFMzVnSkJLcnQycXZrWDlITDMxREpzZXlJaFBMbDNPNzBUOUJxU1ZzYw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a></span></li>

</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Geopolitical and Macro Pressures:</strong> Indian markets remain under pressure from Middle East tensions and global inflation fears, which have exacerbated the ongoing sell-off in domestic equities.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxQLXpERktscWpOejhqd3BacDdvUFI1eE5VcnFOWHZQZl80c2FwdmIzMUdkZEhNMmVpZDg1bXF6UHJGZml1LWlXdGFJSThTcjAxZk5OelVBclBneG84ZTJ4bVcxOXdOLWtuWWpLWGM5RnlFdFJnVU9jN1B4MWdENGtFMzVnSkJLcnQycXZrWDlITDMxREpzZXlJaFBMbDNPNzBUOUJxU1ZzYw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Currency and Capital Flows:</strong> The Indian Rupee faced volatility against the US dollar, requiring RBI intervention to stabilize, while FPI inflows show signs of easing, potentially tempering the domestic bond rally.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W9</a></span></li>
